meta.title: feat: Make RightPane resizable
meta.body_summary: Replace drag-based RightPane resize with click-based expand/collapse using useResize hook and requestAnimationFrame for better performance and UX.

perf_labels.notes: Devin PR for RightPane resize with click-based expand/collapse; maintainer tested via deploy preview and closed without merge, no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1022 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-sized frontend refactor. As an incremental UI performance feature, it was closed without merge, consistent with lack of maintainer adoption or possibly functional shortcomings.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or developer feedback on the performance claim or implementation; PR closed after manual testing without comment.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace drag-based resize with click-based expand/collapse for better performance, using useCallback and smooth transitions.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR after deploying previews multiple times without any review comment; no merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Frontend UI resize feature involving custom hook and component refactor; Agent delivered changes but maintainer did not accept, possibly due to functionality or UX issues not explicitly stated.

detection_detail.manual_testing: Maintainer requested multiple build-deploy-preview deployments (skip-tests=true) and tested the UI manually before closing without further comment.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or before/after metrics; only narrative claim that click-based is more performant.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after maintainer tested preview without providing feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced drag-based resize with click-based expand/collapse on RightPane using a new useResize hook with requestAnimationFrame, removed RightPaneResizeWrapper, refactored StaticLayout, and added smooth transitions.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: RightPaneResizeWrapper was added then removed; PropertyPaneResizableHandle is a rename of RightPaneResizableHandle; EntityExplorerResizeHandler and useResize changes were partially discarded.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added RightPaneResizeWrapper with drag-based resizing
Removed RightPaneResizeWrapper in favor of useResize hook, added RightPaneResizableHandle
State management and style fixes by maintainer
Added requestAnimationFrame for smoother resizing in useResize
Major refactor: replaced drag-based resize with click-based expand/collapse, removed many lines from useResize
Discarded changes to EntityExplorerResizeHandler and useResize, then re-applied via merge
